Task description (A) offers 'extend an existing cross-language test (LanguageDerivationTest.lean / ValidityLayerTest.lean)' as an alternative to a new NomicLanguage test module. Both are structurally unavailable: ValidityLayerTest pins defeq against the generic PointTruth/TaskFrame validity layer, and NomicValidity is built on NomicFrame D (a different frame type that cannot instantiate PointTruth -- NomicTruth.lean's module docstring records exactly why); LanguageDerivationTest exercises proof systems, and NomicLanguage is a semantic-only component with no proof system. A new module is the only viable route for (A).

Finding (C) is narrower than stated: Tests/BimodalTest/Automation/NormalizationTest.lean already uses 'simp only [formula_unfold]'/'[formula_fold]' (both declared in FormalSystem/Tactic/Attr.lean) at ~14 sites, and LemmaDBTest.lean already reads 'Lean.labelled `tmLemma'. So 3 of Attr.lean's 5 declarations are already exercised; the genuine gaps are truth_norm, reflect_time_norm, and all 5 defs of Tactic/Meta.lean (zero references under Tests/).

Writing the item (C) smoke probe for FormalSystem/Tactic/Meta.lean uncovered a LIVE bug: buildContextExpr's first line is 'mkAppM ``List.nil #[formulaType]', but List.nil takes zero explicit arguments, so mkAppM throws 'too many explicit arguments provided to @List.nil' on EVERY input, empty list included. Measured via lean_run_code: buildContextExpr [] and buildContextExpr [p] both throw. The two consumers (Search.lean:475 tryModalK, Search.lean:527 tryTemporalK) call it OUTSIDE their 'observing?' block, so the exception propagates: 'example : |-[FrameClass.Base] box (p imp p) := by modal_search' fails with that AppBuilder error. Fixing it means editing a FormalSystem declaration, which this task's description puts explicitly out of scope -- flagged as a user_decision on .return-meta.json.

All four recommended artifacts (NomicLanguage test module, ForMathlib smoke module, and the two Automation folds) were compiled green via lean_run_code BEFORE being written into the report, including both host files' exact import closures -- so the plan phase inherits pre-validated content and the implement phase should need no discovery. The compile pass also caught two defects in my own ForMathlib draft (an unnecessarySimpa warning and a 'No goals to be solved') that a prose-only recommendation would have shipped.

First plan draft concluded that a Tests/-only change trips NEITHER coupled generated surface, based on reading scripts/typst-sync-check.sh's LEAN_SRC_ROOTS (FormalSystem/ + BimodalTools/). That is the DECLARATION-scan scope, not the count-field scope: scripts/typst-status-counts.sh derives tests-file-count and tests-line-count from a recursive count under Tests/, and .githooks/pre-commit blocks any commit staging a .lean path while typst/generated/status.typ has drifted. Caught by validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification check, whose selector run returned two suites the justification did not name because plan-file-scope-harvest.sh auto-appends status.typ for any .lean path. Plan revised: status.typ now declared in all three phases' Files to modify with a same-phase regeneration step.

validate-artifact.sh's Tier Justification under-verification warning caught a real, commit-blocking gate omission at plan-acceptance time rather than at the first phase commit. The warning was not cosmetic: the two extra suites it named traced back to plan-file-scope-harvest.sh's generated-surface auto-append, which was the only signal that typst/generated/status.typ was in scope at all. Also a win: the research dispatch had compiled every artifact before writing it down, so all four deliverable shapes, the seven axiom profiles, the F3 regularity haveI binding and two rejected Sierpinski tactic forms were measured inputs, not planning guesses.

scripts/typst-sync-check.sh --fix moved a THIRD field beyond the two tests-* counts: stamp-commit ca101c1c5 -> 31e818429. Diagnosed as benign provenance, not the FormalSystem-writer drift the plan's Risks row predicts: stamp_commit is just git rev-parse --short HEAD in scripts/typst-status-counts.sh, and HEAD advanced under this dispatch because a concurrent sibling committed 31e818429 ('tasks 944-957: create proof-mode programme'). The formalsystem-file-count/line-count fields did not move. The plan's stop-and-diagnose rule should name stamp-commit as an expected-to-move provenance field so a future implementer does not read it as a red flag.

Phase 1's NomicLanguage module compiled first-try with zero diagnostics except one fixable example, and all seven #guard_msgs axiom-profile expected strings matched exactly on the first run. The research dispatch's measured profile table and its 'F3.IsRegular does not synthesize, bind with haveI' note were both load-bearing and both correct, so no exploration was needed.

Both new modules overran the plan's line-count hypotheses, for the same structural reason in each case: Phase 1's module is 175 lines against a ~115 estimate, Phase 2's is 141 against ~70. The content is exactly what the plan's task lists name -- Phase 2's overrun is almost entirely the literal 'a #check per public declaration' instruction meeting Order/PFilter.lean's 31 public declarations, which no line estimate derived from 'one smoke check per file' would predict. Both Scope-Hypothesis confirmation criteria held in both phases (three changed paths / one import line, and the per-file headline-declaration references), so the overrun is in the estimate, not the scope. A future plan sizing a ForMathlib-style smoke module should count the target files' public declarations rather than their file count.

Phase 3 edited one README beyond the three its task list names: Tests/BimodalTest/README.md gained a ForMathlib/ bullet in its Test Organization list. Rationale: the phase Goal says 'bring the hand-maintained test READMEs back in step with the two new modules', and a brand-new top-level test DIRECTORY absent from the parent organization list is exactly that drift -- distinct from the per-file omissions that list already carries throughout (Semantics/ lists 3 of 15 files). Also added a LemmaDBTest.lean row to Automation/README.md, which had none, because the Tactic/Meta.lean fold lives there and the plan asked for the fold to be noted. Both edits reuse the existing row/bullet shapes; no shape was invented.

verify-touched.sh (the scoped discharge this dispatch's Batch Gate Deferral mandates) exits 1 with 11 NEW failing .claude/scripts/tests suites. Fully attributed as pre-existing and out of this task's file scope, per plan-authoring-gate-collisions.md Condition 4: every one of the 11 fails on a missing LOCAL source store -- assertions read 'required source file(s) not found: .../agent-system/extensions/core/...' and 'agent-system/extensions does not exist'. This repository has no agent-system/ directory at all; .claude-extensions.json points every source_dir at /home/benjamin/.config/nvim/agent-system/extensions/*. The 11 suites therefore fail unconditionally here regardless of any task, and none of them references Tests/, typst/ or FormalSystem/ (grep -c = 0 for all 11). Cost: a full 95-suite run plus triage to establish non-attribution. Durable fix would be for those suites to SKIP rather than FAIL when the resolved source_dir is outside the repository -- otherwise every Lean-side dispatch in this deploy-only repo pays this triage again.
